title: A JOYFUL SPECIAL SCROLL LETTER

blocks.text: “Trust you are happy and enjoying the messages. May you have a joyous, very spiritual Merry Christmas and may you have healing and health all year round!” – “At this time of the year we should really praise Jesus and reveal who He actually is; also about the eternal triune Godhead!” – Col. 1:15-18, “He is the image of the invisible God, and all things were created by Him in heaven and in earth. Verse 18, “He is the very head in all things. He is the preeminence, meaning first, over all!” – Col. 2:9-10, “All the fullness of the Godhead dwelled in Him, the head of all principality and power!” – I Tim. 6:14-15 says, “the only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords!” – Verse 16, “the only one who hath immortality, dwelling in eternal light which no man can approach, and no man hath see Him in this form; for it is the direct form when he is the eternal light of the Holy Spirit burning glory!” – “But we look upon Him in the Sonship, the image of His eternal being!” (Study all verses closely.)

Isa.9:6, “The prophet says, the mighty God, the everlasting Father, the Prince of Peace in speaking of the revealing of Jesus!” – “When you find out who He is you have more power and you have more faith, confidence, rest and peace!” – “That is why Jesus said in St. Matt. 28:19 to baptize in the name of deity, all three in one!” – St. John 5:43, wherein it says, “I came in my father’s name, Lord Jesus! And the apostles baptized just like Jesus told them to do, in the name! Acts 2:38, it says and every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit! Also in Acts 8:16, repeats the command, in the name! – That is why Jesus said in Matt. 28:18, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth!”

“Now we must compare Scriptures to bring out the full revelation! The elect know it by revelation and faith! – But some people by misunderstanding think the Scriptures say it one way, then another way. Jesus knew the world and lukewarm would not seek out the total truth!” – Eph. 4:4-5, “One Lord, one faith, one baptism!” – “Now let’s be fair and bring out the other Scriptures. Some find certain Scriptures hard to understand, but Jesus can easily answer it!” Mark 16:19, “it calls Him Lord and then says, He sat on the right hand of God! And in Heb. 1:3 brings Him out as the expressed image, then again set down on the right hand of the Majesty on high! Then Jesus says in St. John 12:45, that he that seeth me has seen the one who sent Me!” – St. John. 10:30, “I and My Father are One!” – “When He sits on the right hand of power or God, it means He is in one of His forms standing by His Holy Spirit power, which He says is all power! When it is all over with He will sit down in His throne as the Eternal One!” – “It’s like this in His different manifestations, God the Father, God the Son, God the Holy Spirit! Let me explain it this way, you can have three light bulbs of power, but it’s the same Holy Spirit light going through them!” One Eternal light in three manifestations of the same Holy Spirit!

Now we can explain Dan. 7:9, 13, “Wherein he saw the Ancient of days setting on the Throne, and they brought the Son of man near to Him! The angels actually got to see the body of Jesus that God himself would come in! Emmanuel (Matt. 1:23) means God with us!” – “Now let me explain what it means when He sat down by the right hand of God!” – St. John 1:1, 14 was given these words in order to explain the right hand of God, wherein it says, “In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, (see standing by the hand of God), and the Word WAS GOD! And the Word (Jesus) was made flesh and came down and talked to us, else we could not look upon Him as the eternal Holy Spirit!” – This is exactly what Dan. 7:13 saw, “was the Word was with God and the Word, was God standing before the angels!”

I John 5:7, “For there are three that bear record in heaven, The Father, the Word and the Holy Ghost, and these three are one!” – “These three work together, but are the same eternal Holy Spirit!” – “Some sincere groups try to bring out a trinity, then they also turn around and teach One God. The word trinity is not even in the Bible; the proper word would be triune! – They try to please both sides! – They say three personalities, then turn around and say One God, but Scriptures confirm there is one personality, and three manifestations of the same One Holy Spirit!” James 2:19, “The devil believes there is one God and trembles!” – I Tim. 3:16 says, “it was a great mystery, but God was manifest in the flesh, (the mystery). – John 8:58, Jesus said, Before Abraham was, I am! And St. John 13:13, Jesus said He was Master and Lord! – St. John 1:3 says, All things were made by Him, and that no one else in heaven made anything except He made it Himself!”

In Matt. 4:7, 10, “Jesus told Satan, Don’t tempt Him, because He was the very God to come in the flesh, and He was the only one to be worshipped!” – “And in John 9:37-38 we see Jesus being worshipped as Lord! And the Bible says that God is the only one that can be worshipped!” – “Let us explain St. John 14:28 wherein Jesus said, My Father is greater than I! Yes, while He was in the dimension of flesh, but not when He returned back to the eternal Holy Spirit! Verse 26 proves this because the Holy Spirit comes back in the name of Jesus!” – “Now the Lord will give us a real eye opening Scripture to prove all of this!” St. John 14:8-9, “Where Philip said, Lord show us the Father! And Jesus said, I’ve been with you all of the time and thou hast not known Me? He that has seen Me has seen the very Father! And how can you say, show us the Father when you are looking at Him!” (Study this!) – Zech. 14:9, “Jesus will be King over all the earth and there shall be one Lord, and his name one!”

“So here is the mystery to His elect Bride! There is one supreme eternal spirit, working as, God the Father, God the Son, God the Holy Spirit, and heaven bears record that THESE THREE ARE ONE! Thus saith the Lord, read ye this and believe it!” Rev. 1:8, “I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending saith the Lord, which is, and which was and which is to come, the Almighty!” – Rev. 19:16, “King of kings, and Lord of lords!” – Rom. 5:21, “Unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord!” – Rom. 1:20 sums up the whole matter, “Even His eternal power and Godhead so that they are without excuse!” – “All things are done perfectly well, believe! Amen!”
